summary: Verified Phase 1 auth fixes (pbkdf2 hashing + REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL /api suffix) and Phase 2 ICP Engine integration end-to-end. Backend: 7/7 pytest cases green in /app/backend/tests/test_phase1_phase2.py including (a) existing verified user login, (b) signup with pbkdf2$210000$ hash format in DB + login roundtrip on same account, (c) wrong-password 401, (d) 5-failed-attempts lockout now returns 429 (previous iteration's brute-force bug is fixed - lockout keys on email only now), (e) POST /api/icp/generate 422 when businessStage/priority missing, (f) real external ICP Engine API call returns completed with populated chip groups. Frontend Playwright: login via /login redirects to /dashboard, signup at /signup with a fresh unique email also redirects to /dashboard, ICP form at /icp (route is /icp not /icp-engine) with the two new shadcn selects (business-stage=Growth, priority=Balanced) plus multiselect country/industry generates a real AI ICP with Industry/Target Roles/Geography/Key Pain Points chip groups all populated and Company Size intentionally empty - matches the design.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py verify_password wraps salt/hash b64url decoding in `except (ValueError, Exception)` - the Exception clause is redundant since it catches everything; simplify to `except Exception`.

icp_router.generate_icp swallows all exceptions from the external API into a generic status='failed' with no user-visible error detail (only server log). Consider returning the failure reason (timeout / 5xx / bad JSON) in the response so the UI can show a specific toast rather than a silent 'failed'.

icp_router.generate_icp: businessStage and priority are declared as required strings but there is no enum/whitelist validation - the frontend defaults to 'Growth'/'Balanced' but a caller could POST arbitrary values that the external ICP engine may reject. Consider Literal[...] typing to mirror the shadcn dropdown options.

icp_router._upsert_company_profile does a SELECT-then-INSERT/UPDATE, not an atomic ON CONFLICT upsert. Two concurrent generate calls for the same customer could race and duplicate rows if there is no unique index on customer_id.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression suite for this phase is /app/backend/tests/test_phase1_phase2.py (7 tests, all green). It calls the REAL external ICP Engine at ICP_ENGINE_API_URL and can take ~10-20s; keep a generous timeout when running. Frontend ICP route is /icp (not /icp-engine). Business stages: ['Pre-Seed / Idea','Early Stage (MVP)','Growth','Scale-up','Enterprise / Mature'], defaults to 'Growth'. Priorities: ['Speed','Quality','Cost','Balanced'], defaults to 'Balanced'. Company Size chip group is intentionally empty in ICP results (real API does not return it). Auth uses pbkdf2$210000$<salt>$<hash> for new signups; legacy bcrypt hashes ($2b$) still work via fallback in auth.py:verify_password. Brute-force lockout bug from iteration_1 is fixed - now keys on email only. Leads /generate is out of scope per main agent's note (live n8n test in progress), do not touch.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A - all reported fixes verified working. The iteration_1 brute-force lockout bug (identifier=host:email fragmenting behind k8s ingress) is resolved by keying identifier on email alone in auth_router.login line 74.
